newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius bourse index rises marginally.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius bourse index rises marginally.

text.p: The Mauritius bourse index Semdex rose a marginal 0.04 points on Friday to 379.28, brokers and officials said.
Traded volume was posted at 4.91 million rupees on 227,419 shares from 10.77 million rupees on 262,532 shares on Wednesday. The bourse trades on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays.
"Stocks were traded mixed to-day -- in the absence of a general market trend," one broker said. "Among the blue chips, some are upmoving stocks while the others are downmoving ones."

Brokers said the bourse was not very active and there was a lack of liquidity on the market. They added that the small volume traded did not reflect the buoyant mood that normally prevailed on Fridays.
"The heavyweights in the banking sector were clear examples of the mixed market position to-day," said another broker.
State Commercial Bank rose 10 cents to 12.80 rupees on 82,700 shares and Mauritius Commercial Bank eased 50 cents to 89.50 rupees on 2,543 shares.
Hotel-based Sun Resorts rose 10 cents to 47.50 on 10,300 shares, New Mauritius Hotels gained 80 cents to 38 on 48,437 shares and Grand Baie Hotel was stable at 50 on 875 shares.
In the commerce sector, conglomerates Ireland Blyth Ltd lost 20 cents to 15.60 on 1,640 shares. Rogers fell a rupee to 92 on 1,994 shares. Shell was 10 cents down to 20.50 on 1,375 shares.
Sugar stock Mon Tresor Mon Desert was stable at 38.90 on 1,202 shares and Savannah was unchanged at 130 on 792 shares.
Air Mauritius lost 10 cents to 35.30 on 1,738 shares.
